Title: School Name Fields Accept Special Characters & Numbers
StepsToReproduce: Open School Onboarding. Enter special characters and numbers in Full Legal Name and Short Name. Click Continue.
ActualResult: Field accepts special characters and numbers.
ExpectedResult: Only alphabetic characters should be allowed.

Title: Affiliation Number Validation Missing
StepsToReproduce: Enter alphabets and special characters in Affiliation Number. Save.
ExpectedResult: Affiliation Number should accept only valid alphanumeric values as per the required format.

Title: 'Other' Board Option Missing Input Field
StepsToReproduce: Select Other in Board selection.
ExpectedResult: A text field should appear to allow the user to enter the board name.

Title: School Type Text Overflow
StepsToReproduce: Open School Type selection.
ExpectedResult: Text should be displayed properly within the UI.

Title: Continue Button Causes Infinite Loading & Logout
StepsToReproduce: Fill onboarding details. Click Continue. Reopen the application.
ActualResult: Loader continues indefinitely and the user is logged out.
ExpectedResult: User should proceed to the next screen without being logged out. Note: Not able to select the start and end date of admission.

Title: Wrong Screen Opens from Quick Action
StepsToReproduce: Open Dashboard. Click Add Student under Quick Actions.
ExpectedResult: Student Details screen should open.

Title: Announcement Screen Header Missing
StepsToReproduce: Click Announce from Quick Actions.
ExpectedResult: Screen header should be visible.

Title: Report Screen Header Missing
StepsToReproduce: Click Report from Quick Actions.
ExpectedResult: Report screen should display the header.

Title: Incorrect Analytics Data
StepsToReproduce: Login with a newly created school. Open Analytics.
ExpectedResult: Analytics should be empty or reset for a new school.

Title: Teacher Assignment Screen Overlapping
StepsToReproduce: Add a teacher. Click Assign Task.
ActualResult: UI overlaps and functionality does not work.
ExpectedResult: Screen should display correctly and assignment should work.

Title: Teacher Edit Profile Not Working
StepsToReproduce: Open Teacher Profile. Click Edit.
ActualResult: Profile screen opens again without edit functionality.
ExpectedResult: Teacher details should be editable.

Title: Danger Zone UI Overlapping
StepsToReproduce: Open Teacher/Profile Settings. Scroll to Danger Zone.
ExpectedResult: Danger Zone should be displayed properly.

Title: Newly Added Teacher Not Visible
StepsToReproduce: Add another teacher. Return to Teachers list.
ActualResult: New teacher is not visible until searched. Text alignment is broken.
ExpectedResult: New teacher should appear immediately with proper alignment.

Title: Non-Teaching Staff Role Field
StepsToReproduce: Add Non-Teaching Staff.
ExpectedResult: Role should be a dropdown.

Title: Teacher & Non-Teaching Tab Overlap
StepsToReproduce: Switch between Teacher and Non-Teaching tabs.
ExpectedResult: Only the selected tab should be fully visible.

Title: Dashboard Staff Count Incorrect
StepsToReproduce: Add 2 Teachers and 1 Non-Teaching Staff. Open Dashboard.
ExpectedResult: Dashboard should show a total of 3 staff members.

Title: Common Hub Tab Overlapping
StepsToReproduce: Switch between tabs in Common Hub.
ExpectedResult: Tabs should switch correctly without overlap.

Title: City & Pincode Mismatch
StepsToReproduce: Edit School Profile. Enter Varanasi PIN Code. Set City as New Delhi.
ExpectedResult: City should be validated against the entered PIN Code.

Title: Invalid PIN Code Accepted
StepsToReproduce: Enter an invalid PIN Code. Save.
ExpectedResult: Application should reject invalid PIN Codes.

Title: Inconsistent Dropdown Design
StepsToReproduce: Compare onboarding Role dropdown with other dropdowns.
ExpectedResult: A consistent dropdown design should be used throughout the application.

Title: School Location Mismatch
StepsToReproduce: Create a school in Bangalore. Save profile.
ExpectedResult: Location should match the selected city/state.

Title: Duplicate Principal Email
StepsToReproduce: Open School Profile. Navigate to Contact Details.
ExpectedResult: Only one Principal Email field should be displayed.

Title: Settings Screen Refresh Loop
StepsToReproduce: Open Settings. Pull to refresh or revisit the page.
ActualResult: Screen keeps refreshing continuously and requires reopening the app.
ExpectedResult: Settings page should refresh only once and remain stable.

Title: Add Class & Add Student Visible Everywhere
StepsToReproduce: Open Classes, Subjects, or Schedule tabs. Observe the available actions.
ActualResult: "Add Class" and "Add Student" actions appear on all tabs.
ExpectedResult: Only relevant actions should be displayed for each tab.

Title: Class Code Class Name & Section Accept Invalid Values
StepsToReproduce: Add a class. Enter special characters/numbers in Class Code, Class Name, and Section.
ExpectedResult: Appropriate validation should be applied to each field.

Title: Incorrect Teacher Subject Mapping
StepsToReproduce: Assign Ritika as a Hindi teacher. Open Teacher Profile or Subject Assignment.
ActualResult: Ritika is shown as both Hindi and Mathematics teacher.
ExpectedResult: Only assigned subjects should be displayed.

Title: Unable to Assign Teacher to Multiple Classes
StepsToReproduce: Assign Sanjay to Class 10. Try assigning him to Class 11.
ActualResult: Only one class can be selected.
ExpectedResult: A teacher should be assignable to multiple classes.

Title: Teacher Not Available in Class Assignment
StepsToReproduce: Open Class Assignment. Try assigning Sanjay.
ActualResult: Only two teachers appear in the list.
ExpectedResult: All available teachers should be displayed.

Title: No Validation for Duplicate Teacher Assignment
StepsToReproduce: Assign the same teacher to two classes simultaneously.
ExpectedResult: A validation message should be shown for duplicate assignment.

Title: Unable to Add Teacher from Schedule
StepsToReproduce: Open Schedule. Try adding a teacher.
ExpectedResult: Teacher should be added successfully.

Title: Incorrect Teacher Subject Display
StepsToReproduce: Open Kajal's Teacher Profile.
ActualResult: She is shown as an English teacher as well as Physics and Chemistry teacher.
ExpectedResult: Only assigned subjects should be displayed.

Title: Invalid Error While Adding Exception
StepsToReproduce: Add an exception. Save.
ExpectedResult: Exception should be created successfully or a meaningful validation message should be shown.

Title: Unable to Edit Transport/Vehicle Route
StepsToReproduce: Open Transport. Edit an existing vehicle route.
ExpectedResult: Vehicle route should be editable.

Title: Library Onboarding Wizard Error
StepsToReproduce: Open Library onboarding wizard. Continue through the steps.
ExpectedResult: Library onboarding should complete successfully.

Title: Unable to Add Library Category
StepsToReproduce: Open Library.
ExpectedResult: Category should be added successfully.

Title: Underscore in Fee Structure Label
StepsToReproduce: Open Fee Structure.
ExpectedResult: Label should be displayed without underscores.

Title: Duplicate English Option in Preferences
StepsToReproduce: Open Settings → Preferences.
ExpectedResult: Each language should appear only once.

Title: Non-Teaching Staff UI Overlapping
StepsToReproduce: Open Non-Teaching Staff section.
ExpectedResult: UI should be properly aligned.

Title: Invalid Academic Year Dates Accepted
StepsToReproduce: Enter an End Date earlier than the Start Date. Save.
ExpectedResult: End Date should not be earlier than Start Date.

Title: Attendance Allowed on Non-School Day
StepsToReproduce: Login as Teacher. Open Attendance on a non-school day. Submit attendance.
ExpectedResult: Attendance submission should be blocked on non-school days.

Title: Project Column UI Issue
StepsToReproduce: Open Marks tab.
ActualResult: Project field goes outside the layout.
ExpectedResult: Project field should remain properly aligned.

Title: Class Goal Not Visible
StepsToReproduce: Add a Class Goal. Search for it in the application.
ActualResult: Class Goal is not visible anywhere.
ExpectedResult: Added Class Goal should be displayed in the appropriate section.

Title: Unable to Add Mentor
StepsToReproduce: Open Mentor section. Add a mentor.
ExpectedResult: Mentor should be added successfully.

Title: Period Update Request Cannot Be Submitted
StepsToReproduce: Open Period Update Request. Fill required details. Submit.
ExpectedResult: Period update request should be submitted successfully.

Title: Incorrect Label - Appearance
StepsToReproduce: Open the relevant Settings screen.
ExpectedResult: The label should be Language.
